summary_1line: Duryodhana’s jealousy of the Pandavas leads Sakuni to propose defeating Yudhishthira through a deceitful dice game, which they present to Dhritarashtra.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana, pale with jealousy, stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra while describing the immense wealth and glory of Yudhishthira’s sacrifice.
Sakuni leans close to Duryodhana and reveals his plan to defeat Yudhishthira through a rigged game of dice.
In memory, Vasudeva pours sacred sea water from golden jars while conches sound during Yudhishthira’s magnificent Rajasuya sacrifice.
